2024_194_dec_2023_pcard_report.paragraph: Purchasing-card (PCARD) transaction listing for Troy School District covering December 2023, printed 2/21/2024 and carried on the Board of Education's February 27, 2024 agenda. Each row records a transaction description with merchant and date, the journal-entry description DEC 2023 PCARD EXP, a budget unit, an account code, a transaction amount, and a credits column, running across 33 numbered pages. The report ends with a Subtotal of 273,768.74 in charges against 3,381.84 in credits and Total Expenses of 270,386.90. The single largest charges include 8,785.00 to C & G Publishing, 8,100.00 to World's Finest, 7,055.52 to BSN Sports, and 6,803.00 to Biddergy.
